system.description:
Gained at Level 8. Limit: 1.

You pull energy from your Soul Armament to manifest it into an orb with the visage of your eye. You cast it 6 spaces into the air above you — it follows your space and lasts until the end of combat. It has 20 Durability. While your Eye is active, you do not need Line of Sight to target a creature with your Hexes, as long as the target is within reach of your Armament.
